purpose: Define the minimal reusable HTML/CSS-oriented primitive set shared by Expose MetaModules and pages, avoiding duplicated component foundations across modules.

topics.name: Web Base Primitives
topics.purpose: Define the minimal reusable HTML/CSS-oriented primitive set shared by Expose MetaModules and pages, avoiding duplicated component foundations across modules.

semantics.reuse_rule: Expose modules reuse Web Base primitives before defining module-specific presentation primitives.
semantics.semantic_rule: Primitive names/types describe presentation behavior, not domain business semantics.
semantics.js_rule: JavaScript is optional at the primitive layer and should not be required where HTML/CSS semantics suffice.
semantics.accessibility_rule: Primitive contracts carry machine-readable accessibility requirements where relevant.
semantics.composition_rule: Higher UI components compose primitives rather than fork private foundations.
semantics.authority_rule: Web Base primitive presence does not grant operation/data authority.

invariants.rule: Web Base, style, assets and responsive layout define reusable presentation primitives only; they do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: module duplicates shared primitive without need
primitive requires JS without declared need
accessibility requirement omitted where primitive requires it

references.purpose: MetaModules compose shared Web Base primitives.

prose.summary: Define the minimal reusable HTML/CSS-oriented primitive set shared by Expose MetaModules and pages, avoiding duplicated component foundations across modules.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against existing Expose/Web Base/style contracts and whole-tree Contract Format 1.4 validation.
